lines.say: Spaceport America, New Mexico. May twenty-sixth, twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: On the runway: a jet the size of an F-16, with nobody in it.
lines.say: On the runway: a jet the size of an F sixteen, with nobody in it.

lines.text: Hermeus calls it Quarterhorse Mark 2.1. One Pratt & Whitney F100, a fighter engine, flown by a pilot on the ground.
lines.say: Hermeus calls it Quarterhorse, Mark two point one. One Pratt and Whitney F one hundred, a fighter engine, flown by a pilot on the ground.

lines.text: It has flown exactly twice. This is flight three.
lines.say: It has flown exactly twice. This is flight three.

lines.text: Over White Sands Missile Range, the throttle goes forward.
lines.say: Over White Sands Missile Range, the throttle goes forward.

lines.text: The airplane is now outrunning its own sound.
lines.say: The airplane is now outrunning its own sound.
Top speed: Mach one point two one.

lines.text: That came less than three months after its first flight, and 364 days after the first airplane this company ever flew.
lines.say: That came less than three months after its first flight, and three hundred sixty-four days after the first airplane this company ever flew.

lines.text: Hermeus called it a pace of execution “extremely rare in modern aviation.”
lines.say: Hermeus called it a pace of execution, extremely rare in modern aviation.

lines.text: The next airplane, Mark 2.2, is already being built.
lines.say: The next airplane, Mark two point two, is already being built.
